args.body: Advance AGENCY-QA-PARTNER-INTAKE under a valid lease. Start with the existing prospect evidence and focus on a first-party intake that explicitly invites subcontracted project services and plausibly covers launch QA. Distinguish this from the separate WebSharx role and general-contact route. For a fit, use the existing link-checker evidence and prepare one copy-ready private offer for ten buyer-selected public links with an evidence table, a provisional fee and explicit treatment of refused or ambiguous checks. Record the exact intake and operator decision required. If the bounded search falls short, preserve the decisive source evidence and the condition that would reopen the route. Read back the result and close with a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.

description: WebSharx’s current role page returned HTTP 403, so the archived wording cannot establish an active opportunity. The link checker passed 21 of 21 offline tests. Public FETCH separately retrieved the example homepage and refused the 404 probe. Test how those outcomes can be reported in a buyer deliverable, and pursue the separate agency partner-intake route using first-party evidence. Feedback has no classified commercial signal and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue.
